service.name: corewaf-bridge
service.description: Phase 2 bridge stack — caddy-internal (docker-label proxy + ACME), caddy-bridge (operator action listener), alloy (telemetry), valkey (state). Launched by `orchestrator run` from the foundation tier (waf/corewaf-starter-kit/compose.yml's `orchestrator` service) once `tunnel` is healthy. `run` applies the docker.volumes declarations before docker-compose-up; the `compose` verbs are operational-only primitives (post orchestrator commit 6a0d7fc).

secrets._comment: Overlay identity. The api-minted caddyInstanceUuid is served from a file on the tunnel_state volume (LOCALFILE_SECRETS_DIR=/var/lib/tunnel, set on the foundation orchestrator container) that caddy-bridge writes after it registers and learns its meta.uuid. Rendered to CADDY_INSTANCE_UUID env → the bridge-stack compose overlay-site label resolves. allow_empty so first boot (file absent, pre-registration) brings the stack up on the placeholder site instead of failing the secrets gate. Move to a centralized store (waf-secret-manager / aws-secrets-manager) by changing only `provider`.
